TOPIC: Normal[LUXSHARE TECHNOLOGIES (VIETNAM) CO., LTD]_Pick - Offset Z Exceeds the Allowable Specification in NEXIM Without Any Warning_[NXTR]
Communication Content:
Dear Au Trung-san

Here are the designer’s comments on this matter.

The designer’s view is that it is not possible to trigger an error for the “Pickup Offset Z” value in the “Data Check.”

We received a report that an “8EC1” error occurred this time.

Were there any other error codes displayed?

Was there a different error displayed in the “****” part of “8EC1****”?

If you see a “1909” error here, please check the “Solution” section.

ーー

1909

NXTR: The position for the Z axis to move to is outside the movement range.

--

(Solution)

- When an error occurs between reading marks and before parts are picked up:

1.The shape data value for [Pick] - [Offset Z] or [Tray Pick Offset Z] may be too big. Check the value entered.

2. The value measured for feeder pallet levelness may not be correct. In Accessory Software [Module configuration] - [Calibration Settings], select [Feeder pickup height setting] from the drop-down menu and choose [Use default values] or measure the levelness.

- When an error occurs between parts pickup and placement:

1. The shape data value for [Place] - [Offset Z] may be too big. Check the value entered.

ーー

FMV高橋さん

本件データチェックでは“Pickup Offset Z”の異常値をチェックする事は出来ないとの見解です。

CC-0039524にてNXTR V2.00からエラーコードとして1909（Z軸移動範囲異常）等を出す対応をしており、

その対策文内に「Pickup Offset Zが大きすぎる可能性がある、チェックして下さい」と書かれています。

これを以て対策としているとの事です。

コールセンター　濱本

TOPIC: Normal[Luxshare Precision (Yi'an) Co.,Ltd]_No Nozzle to Pick-up Error When Part Height Exceeds Module 2RV Limit_部品の高さがモジュール2RVの制限値を超えた場合、「ノズルが検出されない」エラーが発生する[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Call Center,

Issue:

For small components such as R0201, R0402, C0201, and C0402, when the Part Height/Thickness is set to > 2 mm (exceeding the allowable limit of Module 2RV), the error displayed in Optimize does not reflect the actual root cause.

Action:

1. Do Part Height Check = YES

* Set Part Height/Thickness of the component to > 2 mm.

* When running Optimize, the system reports:

“No nozzle to pick-up”.

* However, when running Data Check, the system reports:

“Part Size”.

2. Do Part Height Check = NO

* Set Part Height/Thickness of the component to > 2 mm.

* When running both Optimize and Data Check, the system reports:

“Part Size”.

We want Center to support the analysis and clarification of the following points:

1. Why does Optimize report “No nozzle to pick-up” when Do Part Height Check = YES, even though the actual cause is that the Part Height/Thickness exceeds the allowable limit of Module 2RV?

2. When Part Height Check = YES, does the Optimize process perform nozzle selection / pick-up compatibility checking first, and therefore report “No nozzle to pick-up” when no suitable nozzle is found, instead of directly reporting Part Height/Part Size?

3. Is there any difference in the checking logic between Optimize and Data Check in this case?

" The program is attached above for your reference and further analysis."

Thank you for your support,

Best regards,

FMV-NAM，

TOPIC: Normal[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_RH20 Nozzle was rust so many_RH20ノズルは錆びていました[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Nguyen Trong Nham (FMV)-san

We asked the design department to review the nozzle and, from FUJI’s perspective, it is difficult to understand why corrosion has occurred only on the WR-M nozzle.

The WR-M nozzle is manufactured from the same material as other nozzles. If the WR-M nozzle inherently had a characteristic that made it more susceptible to corrosion, similar cases would be expected to occur at other customer sites as well. However, no such reports have been identified.

In addition, the area where corrosion has occurred is made of a material with superior corrosion resistance compared with commonly rust-prone materials such as iron. Therefore, our view is that environmental factors alone, such as moderately elevated humidity, are unlikely to cause corrosion to the extent observed in this case.

For this reason, we believe the corrosion may have resulted from a combination of factors, such as contamination from perspiration during manual handling, exposure to strongly acidic or alkaline substances, and/or storage in a highly humid environment.

Furthermore, as stated in the SMTR and Mechanical Reference manuals, nozzles must be stored in an environment with humidity maintained below 30%. Since the storage conditions in this case exceeded the specified limit, we are unable to accept this case under warranty.

Call center Amano

Communication Content:
Dear FMV-The-san,

Is there any update for this case?

The "No Parts" error displayed when a parts issue request is made is caused by the fact that the receiving information has not been reflected in Nexim.

Reason Why the Information Is not being reflected was that the receiving information from the tower (the .ETN files) is currently being stored in the remoterder\output folder.

However, PRS reads receiving information only from the remoterder\notify folder.

Please change the destination folder for receiving information on the tower side from output to notify.

Regarding Parts that have already been received, when using the Neotel Tower interface,

the PRS Refresh function cannot be used (please refer to Note 1 in Section 1.8.4 of the manual).

Required Action

Please perform either option ① or ② below:

① Move the existing .ETN files from the output folder to the notify folder in chronological order (oldest files first).

The .ETN files will be automatically deleted after they are processed by PRS.

② Delete all .ETN files currently stored in the output folder and then receive the parts into the tower again.

Thank you and Best Regards,

Dear Call center

We are writing to formally request a technical analysis regarding error code 8DC50000 – Operation Range Error (Lane 2), which has been encountered during Dual Lane production at our customer's site.

1. PHENOMENON

The error occurs immediately upon initiating production in Dual Lane mode, preventing the machine from continuing normal operation.

To isolate the root cause, the Lane 2 job was removed and the machine was operated in Single Lane mode (Lane 1 only) using the identical product program. Under this condition, production completed successfully with no errors observed.

• The error is fully reproducible in Dual Lane mode.

• Single Lane production (Lane 1) with the same job program operates normally.

• A comparative review of production conditions confirmed the error is exclusively triggered when Lane 2 is active.

• Analysis of the error message indicates that the placement position in Lane 2 exceeds the robot's allowable movement range in the Y-direction.

The following data has been collected and is attached for your reference:

  – Trace Data

  – Event Log

  – Affected Job Program

  – Nexim Software Version

  – Machine Version Information

3. REQUESTED ACTION

Please advise on the recommended countermeasure(s) to resolve this issue and prevent recurrence during Dual Lane production operations.

Your prompt support on this matter is greatly appreciated, as the customer's production is currently impacted.

Should you require any additional information or data, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Best regards,

FMV-Pham Hieu

TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE TECHNOLOGIES (VIETNAM) CO., LTD]_The Module NXTR Right continuously reported error codes 80001203 and 1204. Initial inspection indicated that the vacuum pressure did not meet the required specification, preventing the ma...
Communication Content:
Dear Call Center,

Recently, our customer has encountered an issue with the vacuum pump of the NXTR machine.

- Symptom

Module 1 Right on Line V1-02 repeatedly generated error codes 80001203 and 80001204. Initial inspection found that the vacuum pressure was insufficient, preventing the machine from operating normally.

- Inspection and Troubleshooting Process

The vacuum pressure was checked first and confirmed to be below the required level. The head was then inspected, and all nozzles/covers were properly sealed, eliminating the possibility of vacuum leakage from the head.

Next, the vacuum pump was activated through the I/O screen; however, the right-side vacuum pump did not operate. The machine was restarted, but the same errors remained.

The module was pulled out for further inspection, confirming that the right-side vacuum pump was not running. The pump filter was cleaned, but the issue persisted, ruling out a clogged filter as the cause.

To maintain production, the module was temporarily set to "Skip Module", allowing the production line to continue running.

After production stopped, the inverter boards on the left and right sides were swapped for verification. The fault remained on the right side, indicating that the inverter board was not the root cause.

The left and right vacuum pumps were then swapped. At the same time, all pneumatic tubes were reconnected, and all fuses and connectors on the interface board were reinstalled. After completing these actions, the vacuum pump returned to normal operation.

The machine was then run in "Idle" mode for observation. It operated normally, and no further errors were detected.

- Additional Verification

On the following day, the "Do Part Height Check" and "Do Place Check" functions were enabled in the production program, and the machine operated normally.

A different program with these two functions disabled was then tested, and the same error reoccurred.

Finally, "Do Part Height Check" and "Do Place Check" were enabled again for production. During subsequent monitoring, the machine operated stably, and no recurrence of the error was observed.

- Could you please clarify:

Do these functions change the vacuum control sequence or the timing of vacuum pressure monitoring?

Do they introduce additional delays that allow the vacuum pressure to stabilize before the system performs the vacuum check?

Is there any known relationship between these two functions and the vacuum pump control logic or the generation of error codes 80001203 and 80001204?

- We would appreciate your explanation of the underlying control logic and any recommendations for further troubleshooting.

Detail error:

- Module type: 2RV

- Module SN: 1-L 0000731

- Base SN: 0202163

- Version: (V2.2Bm)

- The trace was collected from 5:15 pm to 5:30pm Aug 3,2026

TOPIC: Urgent[TOA VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Issue with Data Synchronization Between AIMEXIIIc, AIMEX R and XPF in Nexim_AIMEXIII-XPF-AIMEXRのラインにて、AIMEXRでシェイプデータを機上編集し保存。 Neximへ反映後、XPFでも機上でシェイプデータを編集保存し、Neximへ反映すると、最初にAIMEXRで編集した内容が消えてしまっている[AIMEXR]
Communication Content:
Dear FMV-Duy-san

There are two temporary workarounds.

1：After editing a JOB using the on-machine edit function in AIMEXR or AIMEXIII and applying the changes to Nexim,

please resend that JOB to the entire line once.

This issue occurs when you perform an on-machine edit from AIMEXR or AIMEXIIIc, apply the changes to Nexim, and then perform the same operation in XPF.

This specific sequence of steps is the condition under which the issue occurs.

This is caused by the JOB information stored internally in XPF being overwritten when it is synchronized with Nexim.

If you edit the JOB in AIMEXR or AIMEXIII, apply the changes to Nexim, and then transmit that JOB to XPF, you shouldn't encounter any problems.

Furthermore, there are no issues even if you edit a JOB in XPF and then edit it again in AIMEXR or AIMEXIII.

2：When editing in AIMEXR or AIMEXIII, enter the data using “Override.”

For information on override settings, please refer to the “How to specify AIMEXR dedicated settings (Override)” section

in the “AIMEXR Advanced Operation Manual.”

The content is the same in AIMEXIII as well.

However, “Override” can only be used for editable items.

For example, you cannot use “Override” to set placement coordinates.

ーー

Given the situation, I recommend the interim measure described in "1".

We will continue to implement these measures.

BR

Hamamoto

TOPIC: Normal[YASKAWA Vietnam Mechatronics system Co., Ltd.]_Unable to get DID while communicate with Neotel tower_Neotelタワーとの通信時にDIDを取得できない[NXTR]
Communication Content:
Dear FMV-The-san,

Thank you for the update.

The "No Parts" error displayed when a parts issue request is made is caused by the fact that the receiving information has not been reflected in Nexim.

Reason Why the Information Is not being reflected was that the receiving information from the tower (the .ETN files) is currently being stored in the remoterder\output folder.

However, PRS reads receiving information only from the remoterder\notify folder.

Please change the destination folder for receiving information on the tower side from output to notify.

Regarding Parts that have already been received, when using the Neotel Tower interface,

the PRS Refresh function cannot be used (please refer to Note 1 in Section 1.8.4 of the manual).

Required Action

Please perform either option ① or ② below:

① Move the existing .ETN files from the output folder to the notify folder in chronological order (oldest files first).

The .ETN files will be automatically deleted after they are processed by PRS.

② Delete all .ETN files currently stored in the output folder and then receive the parts into the tower again.

Thank you and Best Regards,

Marie Terazawa

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Machine hangup when left robot error 8F1F- can not pull out module_左側ロボットがハングアップ、8F1Fが発生してモジュールアンクランプできない。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Vu-san

This was an application software issue that occurred when an 8F1F error was generated during paired-robot operation in dual-lane production.

In paired production, the backup pin return process is synchronized between the two robots. However, in this case, the left and right robots entered a mutual waiting state, resulting in an application hang-up.

Left robot:

Stopped due to a pin shortage error on Lane 1.

Did not proceed with Lane 2 processing.

Waited for a stop response from the right robot.

Right robot:

After recognizing the pin on Lane 1, no error occurred on the right robot, so it proceeded to Lane 2 processing.

However, before pin recognition on Lane 2, synchronization with the left robot was required.

As a result, it waited for a response from the left robot's Lane 2 process.

We are currently investigating the scope of the fix and its potential impact on related functions. Once the size and complexity of the required modifications have been determined, we will be able to provide a release schedule.

BR.

Moriya

Communication Content:
Dear Sir,

Thank you for your inquiry.

We analyzed the provided performance logs and found

that the communication between the LCU and the machine was unstable during the reported period.

The log shows multiple link down/up events as follows:

19:29:46: Link was already down at the start of measurement

19:30:01: Link recovered (1000 Mbps)

20:27:13 - 20:27:28: Link down for approximately 15 seconds

20:34:14 - 20:34:28: Link down for approximately 14 seconds

Based on these findings, the reported issue is considered to have been caused by unstable network communication between the LCU and the machine.

Although it is difficult to determine from the logs alone whether the root cause was the PC hardware itself or the network cabling, the issue was resolved after replacing the LCU.

Therefore, it is highly likely that the problem was related to the LCU PC side.

We recommend checking the following items if a similar issue occurs in the future.

Network cable condition and connection between the LCU and machine

Network interface status of the LCU

Presence of repeated link down/up events in performance logs

General condition of the LCU PC

Best regards,

Mehdi

Communication Content:
Dear Marie-san,

Thank you for reproducing the issue and for your investigation.

Yes, your understanding is correct.

The customer's expectation is to achieve the best possible cycle time under the following conditions:

• Keep the current feeder arrangement fixed.

• Limit the number of duplicate feeders according to the configured maximum split feeder count.

• When the total number of placements can be evenly divided by the duplicate feeders, Nexim should distribute the placements as evenly as possible.

In our test, manually distributing the placements evenly resulted in a better cycle time than the current optimization result. Therefore, the customer expects Nexim to automatically generate a similar optimization result under the same conditions.

Thank you very much for your support.

Best regards,

FMV-Pham Hieu

TOPIC: Urgent[GOERTEK ELECTRONICS VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED]_Can't read the solder mark_ソルダーマークを読み取れない[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Call center

Already explained below. Please close this ticket.

・You're using the mark read recovery function, right?

For this reason, the recovery function automatically adjusts the brightness so that it can be read.

Since this error is 3504 (mark pitch tolerance exceeded), the machine is reading a mark at a different location.

Since it is reading from a different location, it will continue reading at the same brightness. This is because the recovery function is being used.

Reason Why No Error Occurred During the Restart

・The timing for initializing the read conditions for the recovery function is when the machine restarts or when a job is transmitted from Nexim (it is not initialized when transmitted from the LCU).

・In addition, we changed the scan area before restarting the machine.

And since we were transmitting the job from the LCU, the conditions are not reset.

Finally, after restarting the machine and then transmitting the job from Nexim, the brightness settings were reset.

Additionally, since the scan area was reduced, the brightness was automatically adjusted to read the correct marks, resolving the issue.

Please let me know if anything in my explanation is unclear.

FMV takatsu

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_863F0000 : Unable to download the job_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Cuong-san

The previous ticket, “CC-0074021,” mentioned missing JOB package data.

After checking the new trace data to see if the situation was the same, we determined that the error was caused by a different factor.

The cause of this error was related to the timing of JOB transmission and the reading of the JOB from NXTR.

We have concluded that this is not a bug.

【Timing Details】

1： Job transmission processing started

July 13, 2026, 02:53:31.119 [7] INFO (LCUDataAccessService::LDASIFOnChangeStatus) LDASIFOnChangeStatus IN:ConnectionID:1914BaseName:172.20.7.100Status:1

2：Since “job.xml” already exists on the LCU, a process to temporarily delete it

2026/07/13 02:53:31.579 [11] INFO (CXmlAccessThread::FDataJobDelete) FDataJobDelete IN: ConnectionID:1914 FileID:158994

3：The process by which NXTR attempts to open a job

2026/07/13 02:53:31.913 [20] INFO (CXmlAccessThread::FDataJobOpen) FDataJobOpen IN:ConnectionID:2147483670LogonId:0workOrderNo:FJWKODR0000000195OpenType:1

2026/07/13 02:53:31.913 [20] ERROR (CXmlAccessThread::FDataJobOpen) FDataJobOpen OUT:FDATA_ERROR_NO_FILE: ConnectionID:2147483670

4：The main part of the job transmission process from Nexim. Create a new “job.xml” file.

2026/07/13 02:53:31.945 [10] INFO (CXmlAccessThread::FDataJobOpen) FDataJobOpen IN:ConnectionID:1914LogonId:1367workOrderNo:FJWKODR0000000195OpenType:0

ーー

An error occurred because a JOB was read from NXTR before the new “job.xml” file was created in steps 3 through 4.

An error is occurring at the millisecond level.

The conclusion is that the timing was really bad.

ーー

The cause of the original issue—“missing package data from JOB”—has not yet been identified.

We apologize, but if the error occurs again, please capture the trace once more.

When you do so, please check to see if, as was the case this time, the JOB transmission and the JOB read from NXTR are occurring simultaneously.

Thank you

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Request for Investigation: NXTR Error 8F5A and Nozzle Allocation Issue._[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Call Center !

We would like to request your support regarding the following issue reported by our customer, BYD.

Currently, the NXTR machine reports Error 8F5A when preparing to run the first PCB after the module is started. Before production, the job had already been optimized and Data Check was completed successfully. The job was also transferred to the machine without any error.

After checking the job settings, we found that Nozzle 2.5 had not been assigned to the Nozzle Station, even though this nozzle was correctly specified in the component shape on the corresponding module. However, Nexim did not report any missing nozzle during Optimize or Data Check.

After manually assigning Nozzle 2.5 to the Nozzle Station, another issue occurred. The nozzle was still not allocated to the placement head. At that time, the Nozzle Station contained one standard nozzle type, two special nozzle types, and Nozzle 2.5.

Only after removing one nozzle from one specific special nozzle type was Nozzle 2.5 successfully allocated to the head. However, removing one nozzle from the other special nozzle type did not allow Nozzle 2.5 to be allocated, even though that nozzle type is physically larger.

We would appreciate your investigation and advice on the following two questions:

Why does Nexim not detect or report a missing nozzle during Optimize or Data Check, even though Nozzle 2.5 is required by the job but is not assigned to the Nozzle Station?

Why is Nozzle 2.5 allocated to the head only after reducing the quantity of one specific nozzle type, but not the other? This behavior is unexpected because the nozzle type that must be reduced is physically smaller than the other special nozzle type.

We would greatly appreciate your analysis and advice. If any additional information, logs, or data are required, please let us know and we will provide them promptly.

Thank you very much for your support.

Best regards

Nguyen Anh

TOPIC: Normal[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Component Stack Detection in Nexim_隣接部品干渉のエラー[Nexim]
Communication Content:
Dear Nguyen-san

Ref. SMD-BR67 is located close to SMD-BR68, and both are the same shape data.

Since these are identical components and have the same component height, interference would not normally occur.

However, the Place Offset Z is set to -0.5 mm, which means the previously placed component may interfere with the taper of the nozzle during placement of the next component.

Therefore, the optimization reports this error.

Since it would be difficult to change the component position or size, we recommend one of the following solutions:

- Change the Place Offset Z setting to -0.4 mm.

- Use an RH02 head. However, please note that this will significantly increase the production cycle time.

Best Regards,

FUJI Obata

Communication Content:
Dear Call Center,

I am supporting Goertek Nam Son, CEP,  A9-3F workshop and have encountered the following issue:

Machine suddenly alarm multiple errors while operating normally

Error code:

00003DF3/ Sub: 01FF0007 Unit command timeout

8923D475/ Sub: 0000D475 Mark camera connection error

8922D476/ Sub: 0000D476 Part camera connection error

0000D476/ Sub: 10000005 Communication error

879A0615/ Sub: 00000000 Head start up error; Mark camera not connected error

00001B26/ Sub: 00000000 A temperature error occurred at the X-axis linear motor

I took the following actions and identified the MPI LIGHT CONTROL BOARD (FH2283A0F) board as the cause of the issue:

[ACTION]

1. Reboot machine -> same error

2. Re-plug cables from base to module (at module side) -> same error

3. Re-plug cables of CPU box for module right side -> same error

4. Re-plug cables of Module control board bracket R -> same error

5. Removed Module control board bracket R to check and found out the fuse FH2 was blown

6. Replaced fuse FH2 -> same error -> check fuse FH2 was found blown again -> replaced fuse FH2 second time -> same error occurred and fuse FH2 blown again

7. Check electrical schematic: The fuse FH2 connect to X AXIS BOARD

8. Swap X AXIS BOARD (including X AXIS EXTEND BOARD + MPI LIGHT CONTROL BOARD) + fuse FH2 with other module -> issue was resolved

9. Swap X AXIS EXTEND BOARD to confirm which board failure -> same error occurred and fuse FH2 blown again

10. Swap MPI LIGHT CONTROL BOARD (FH2283A0F) + fuse FH2 with other module -> issue was resolved

We have temporarily replaced the defective board with a board taken from a machine in our office to recover the customer machine operation

We will submit a warranty claim for MPI LIGHT CONTROL BOARD (FH2283A0F), so please support us in expediting the process as much as possible so that we can resolve the issue for the customer asap

And please also support to investigate the reason for this board failure, as the customer would like to understand why this issue occurred on a new machine

I also attached machine trace and error pictures for your reference

Machine information:

NXTR-S ver.: V2.3Ps

Module type: 2RV

Base SN: SE0211548 Mfg. Date: JUNE-2026

Module SN: HEBC21 0001273

Thanks & Br,

FMV - Minh

その為、固定刃のシムを取り除いた所、可動刃と固定刃にギャップが出来、全ストローク動くようになりました。

TOPIC: Urgent[Luxvisions Innovation Technology (Yian) Co., Ltd.]_Panel ID Changed to NOREAD_Q0 / NOREAD_QE in Traceability data file_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Viet-san

This was caused by the fact that traceability data was being output to both files and the database.

The system is normally designed to output data to either a file or the database, but not both.

In this instance, the configuration was set to output to a file.

However, the system layout was configured to "Based on Job," meaning the process also executed an output to the database depending on the specific job settings.

When configured for file output, the PCBRECNO value is always 0; the attempt to output this value to the database as well resulted in a failure.

「Please Confirm」

Does this customer want to output traceability data to a file or to the database?

・If to a file:

  Please configure the following settings in the system layout:

  Set the device trace level to “On” or “Off.”

  Set the line trace level to “Not Traceability.”

・If to the database:

  In the Traceability File Output tool, set file output to OFF.

Please configure the settings to output to only one of them,

and check to see if that resolves the issue.

Thank you

BR

Hamamoto

Communication Content:
Dear Hamamoto-san

Please find my answers to your questions below.

Did this issue occur suddenly?

- Let me provide some background. This is a new factory with two NXTR lines that were installed in April 2026. Since then, the lines have been under commissioning, and mass production has not started yet.

- During the commissioning period, they processed only 1–2 PCBs per day, and both Profiler and Verifier were disabled. Therefore, the factory did not pay much attention to the traceability output files.

- Recently, they increased the number of PCBs processed during commissioning, enabled Profiler and Verifier, and connected the lines to the MES system. After that, the traceability output file issue described earlier was observed.

- We checked the historical traceability output folder and found that the same issue had already occurred with some PCBs in May. Therefore, this issue did not occur suddenly.

Were there times when the panel ID was being read without any problems?

- We checked the historical traceability output folder and found that this issue had already existed before.

Also, does this happen with any PCB?

- On Line 1, the issue occurs with some PCBs.

- On Line 2, the issue occurs with all PCBs.

Were there any changes made before the issue occurred?

- We did not update either the NXTR or NEXIM versions. They are still the same versions as when the lines were installed.

I would also like to share one additional piece of information:

- The factory currently has only 30 carriers for holding PCBs. They scan the Carrier ID for each carrier.

After all 30 carriers have been used once, the same carriers are reused, so the Carrier IDs are repeated.

We are not sure whether the repeated Carrier IDs could have any impact on this issue?

Thank you for your support.

Best regards

Viet

TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE-ICT( VIET NAM) LIMITED]_Can not saving job when using on machine editing due to module alarm 6A030004_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Minh-san,

Progress Update

We would like to provide an update on the current situation.

At present, when a job contains sequences with stack target settings, the system performs a search across all parts in the job, which is causing significant processing time.

Additionally, since this occurs for each sequence, the total processing time increases in proportion to the number of stack target sequences.

This issue has been identified as the root cause of the current error.

As we have determined the cause of the delay, we will now proceed to the correction phase.

Since improvements to the algorithm are required, we would like to inform you of the expected timeline for the fix by sometime next week.

Key Point of This Issue

The key factor in this issue is the number of shape data entries in the job (regardless of whether they are actually used).

To support our improvement work, we would appreciate your cooperation in providing the following information:

①Number of shape data entries

Could you please let us know approximately how many shape data entries exist in the job where this issue is occurring?

As we are currently unable to obtain the job itself, this information will be used as a reference for evaluating the effectiveness of the fix.

②Number of unused shape data entries

Out of the total in ①, if there are any shape data entries that are not actually used in implementation, please let us know how many.

If there are a large number of unused shape data entries, removing them may help reduce processing time.

If possible, we would also appreciate it if you could try verifying the behavior after deleting those unused entries.

Best regards,

Callcenter Ono

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_ZS axis error code 3A19_Zs軸の3A19エラー[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Tung-san

I understand what's going on.

TrayPickOffsetZ is the Z-axis (vertical) offset value used when picking tray components.

It is used to adjust the pick position (height) within the tray cavity up or down.

Positive value: Offset upward

Negative value: Offset downward

In this case, the parts protrude about 10 mm above the top surface of the tray, so TrayPickOffsetZ should be set to +10 mm.

It is currently set to 0, so the nozzles move to a pick position at just the surface of the tray, which causes them to push down on the parts.

Even if the nozzles are pushing, this would not be a problem if the springs in the nozzles could absorb the height difference.

However, in this case, the 10 mm cannot be absorbed, so the Zs axis generates 3A19 errors.

(The Zs axis might be more sensitive than Z1 or Z2, so this will happen.)

I said TrayPickOffsetZ should be set to +10 mm, but that is just a guideline. If the pickup rate decreases, please reduce the offset value.

In this case, Tray Pickoffset Z and Pickup Push Amount for tray don't need to be changed.

TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE-ICT( VIET NAM) LIMITED]_Can not saving job when using on machine editing due to module alarm 6A030004_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Ono-san,

Yes, that is correct. There were Stack Target settings for a total of 12 sequences on Module M8 in this job.

When I changed the Device Configuration from (MFU52 + TUM + Dip Flux Unit) to (MFU52), all of those references were removed. At that time, I suspected that the issue might be related to the Device Configuration, so I performed the test in that way.

However, in the following days, I conducted another test while keeping the original Device Configuration (MFU52 + TUM + Dip Flux Unit) unchanged. Instead, I only removed the “U1000” entries from the Stack Target column of the 12 DRAM sequences. As a result, the job was saved much faster (approximately 13–15 seconds).

Based on this result, I started to suspect that the issue is related to the POP / Stack Target process rather than the Device Configuration itself.

I would also like to share one more observation. When I left only 1, 3, or 6 DRAM references with Stack Target enabled (meaning I skipped 11, 9, or 6 DRAM references, respectively), the job save time increased gradually depending on the number of DRAM references using Stack Target. In other words, the more DRAM references with Stack Target that remained, the longer it took to save the job.

I hope this additional information will be helpful for your investigation.

Thank you very much for your continued support. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,

FMV - Minh

Communication Content:
Dear Marie-san,

Thank you very much for your continuous follow-up and kind support on this case.

Regarding the current status, we would like to share the latest update from our side.

Previously, the phenomenon was observed after editing part data directly on the machine or after updating / retransmitting the job via Line Console, where the machine requested material re-verification (ID / DID related behavior).

After internal discussion and consultation with the our engineering team, we applied the following countermeasures:

Host communication timeout: 60 seconds

Number of host communication retries: 5

After applying the above settings, the same phenomenon has not reoccurred, including cases after part editing on the machine and after job update via Line Console.

The production line has been operating stably for a considerable period without further abnormal behavior.

As mentioned in your previous email (dated May 6th), if there was no further update by mid-May, the case would be closed automatically. Based on this understanding, and since no new issue has been observed on our side, the customer has already regarded this case as closed.

Regarding your recent request to apply additional setting changes and acquire detailed debug logs, we fully understand your intention, as a similar phenomenon may have occurred at another customer. However, at this moment, our customer does not have available time to implement further changes or attempt to reproduce the issue, since there is no current problem and any additional modification may impact stable production.

Therefore, from our side, we would like to kindly request to close this ticket at this time.

If the same phenomenon reoccurs in the future at our customer site, we will promptly reopen the case and cooperate fully to provide necessary logs and information.

Thank you very much for your understanding and continued cooperation.

TOPIC: Urgent[MITAC TECHNOLOGY (VIETNAM) COMPANY LIMITED]_The duration of WorkStageStarted to WorkStageCompleted is not proportional to the state transition duration_WorkStageStarted から WorkStageCompleted までの期間は、状態遷移の所要時間に比例していない。[NXT]
Communication Content:
Dear FMV-DO-san,

Is there any update for this case?

In Picture 1.png (red frame), does the status transition follow 1000 → 5000 → 1000?

The red frame focuses on Module No. 10, so we aggregated each state from the logs.

According to the logs, the transition does not follow 1000 → 5000 → 1000.

Measurement period: 02:54:00 – 03:02:38 (approx. 518 seconds)

Across the entire log, Status = 6 occurs at 04:57:42 for Modules 1, 2, 9, 10, and 7, but this is unrelated to the time period in question.

Within the target period (02:54–03:01), the statuses actually received for Module 10 are only 4, 5, 7, and 9, and no USD-related statuses (5000 or 5500) were transmitted.

When PRD (1000) is entered, an event is issued at the start of board transfer (IN).

This event is generated before WorkStageStarted.

After WorkStageCompleted, board transfer (OUT) occurs.

The PRD (1000) state continues until the board is discharged.

Based on the theoretical values, it is assumed that a large discrepancy occurs due to the time spent waiting for boards.

During the specified time period, WorkStageStarted and WorkStageCompleted occurred 13 times for Module 10.

When measuring the time between WorkStageStarted and WorkStageCompleted,

it is approximately 300 ms, suggesting that Module 10 is simply transferring boards without placing any components.

Thank you and Best Regards,

Marie Terazawa

Callcenter FUJI CORPORATION

TOPIC: Urgent[Luxshare Precision (Yi'an) Co.,Ltd]_MFU had no power when connected to the OCPU._[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Sir,

To address the problem, we would like you to check and carry out the following four items:

1. When did this problem start occurring? (i.e., until when was it functioning normally?)

   For example, two weeks ago, connecting the MFU supplied power normally, but today when you connect the MFU, it no longer supplies power.

2. Is this OCPU used in Nexim-linked operation settings? Please check.

   How to check: Open the cover as per section 4.4.2 of the manual (INS-OCPU-004).

   Connector name: Look for the connector labeled SW3-CNH. If a short harness with a mark tube like “CNH 2EHEXW001800” as described in step 4 of section 4.4.2 is inserted → it is used in Nexim-linked operation settings.

   If no short harness is inserted → it is not used in Nexim-linked operation settings.

3. Does it come with the docking station OPTION? Please check.

   How to check: Verify whether the docking station described in section 11.1.1 of the manual (INS-OCPU-004) is included.

4. Obtain a trace.

   Connect the MFU to the OCPU → capture the trace data at the moment you confirm that the MFU does not power on, and send it.

   How to obtain trace data: Refer to chapters 9.1–9.3 of the manual (INS-OCPU-004).

There's a lot of information, but thanks in advance.

BR,

Adachi

Communication Content:
Dear Ono-san,

I have just received the trace data from the customer and would like to share it with you for further investigation.

Please refer to the attached ZIP file: "M8 error 6A030004 when saving job on machine editing_20260606.zip"

I have summarized the actions taken at that time as follows:

The error first occurred at 08:42:46 on June 6, 2026. After that, the following actions were performed:

Action:

1. Pressed and held the Cycle Stop button for 10 seconds to save the machine trace. (Button pressed at approximately 08:53, June 6, 2026)

2. Checked communication status on the LCU Web page: OK.

3. Checked the Fuji LCU NPI Server services: Running normally.

4. Restarted the services on LCU Web. (Approximately 09:12)

5. Performed Save Job in Machine Editing mode for module M8 → the same error 6A030004 occurred. (Approximately 09:17)

6. Restarted the Line Server PC and LCU PC. The NXTR machine was not restarted. (Approximately 09:30)

7. Performed Save Job in Machine Editing mode for module M8 after restarting the PCs → the same error 6A030004 occurred. (Approximately 09:37)

8. Performed Save Job in Machine Editing mode for module M7 after restarting the PCs → OK.

9. Powered off the base, reconnected all connectors of module CPU box for module M8, and swapped the network cable and network port with module M7.

TOPIC: Normal[TONLY ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY VIETNAM CO.,LTD]_Question about NXTR an optional function to check for feeder tip lift, preventive Feeder collide with the placing head_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Nguyen Trong Nham san

Currently, if the timing of the head moving toward the operator side perfectly overlaps with the moment the feeder is inserted at an angle, interference may occur at the instant it is detected.

Therefore, when inserting a feeder while the machine is operating, it is necessary to carefully ensure that the feeder is inserted correctly and straight.

As an additional countermeasure, the Feeder Interference Prevention Sensor is scheduled to be released in V2.35 (for reference: CC-0075570).

The sensor unit will be installed on the machine pallet, similar to the DX Protector, to detect abnormal feeder insertion. Both hardware and software modifications will be required.

When the sensor detects abnormal insertion, the machine will stop immediately. However, the robot will not retract automatically. Therefore, if the feeder continues to be inserted after detection, interference may still occur. Nevertheless, the extent of the damage will be significantly reduced.

Best regard,

FUJI callcenter takeda.

TOPIC: Urgent[MITAC TECHNOLOGY (VIETNAM) COMPANY LIMITED]_The duration of WorkStageStarted to WorkStageCompleted is not proportional to the state transition duration_WorkStageStarted から WorkStageCompleted までの期間は、状態遷移の所要時間に比例していない。[NXT]
Communication Content:
Dear FMV-DO-san,

In Picture 1.png (red frame), does the status transition follow 1000 → 5000 → 1000?

The red frame focuses on Module No. 10, so we aggregated each state from the logs.

According to the logs, the transition does not follow 1000 → 5000 → 1000.

Measurement period: 02:54:00 – 03:02:38 (approx. 518 seconds)

Across the entire log, Status = 6 occurs at 04:57:42 for Modules 1, 2, 9, 10, and 7, but this is unrelated to the time period in question.

Within the target period (02:54–03:01), the statuses actually received for Module 10 are only 4, 5, 7, and 9, and no USD-related statuses (5000 or 5500) were transmitted.

When PRD (1000) is entered, an event is issued at the start of board transfer (IN).

This event is generated before WorkStageStarted.

After WorkStageCompleted, board transfer (OUT) occurs.

The PRD (1000) state continues until the board is discharged.

Based on the theoretical values, it is assumed that a large discrepancy occurs due to the time spent waiting for boards.

During the specified time period, WorkStageStarted and WorkStageCompleted occurred 13 times for Module 10.

When measuring the time between WorkStageStarted and WorkStageCompleted,

it is approximately 300 ms, suggesting that Module 10 is simply transferring boards without placing any components.

Thank you and Best Regards,

TOPIC: Normal[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Add a function to turn on/off the display of jobs on the Workorder list._リスト上のジョブの表示をオン/オフする機能を追加要求[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Memo

①案１の対応について

顧客側で運用での装置画面上でのジョブダウンロードを禁止するのは難しいのでしょうか？

オペレーターに勝手に触られては困るのであれば、ジョブダウンロードができない設定を設けるだけでなく、装置権限機能によるジョブダウンロード制限が望ましいと考えました。

まずは運用で回避ができないかをご確認いただけないでしょうか？

②最後に伝送したジョブを表示させてほしいという要望の背景について

装置画面上にたくさんのJOBが表示され、オペレータが間違ったJOBをダウンロードしてしまう可能性があるとのことですが、Neximから伝送した後に、機上でジョブを切り替える必要がある状況がいまいち理解できておりません。

LCUに次生産ジョブを予め伝送しておき、オペレーターが段取り替え時に次生産ジョブを装置上からダウンロードする運用をしているのでしょうか？

オペレーターがJOBを機上でダウンロードする必要に至る状況についてご教示いただけないでしょうか？

③「NXT機でのジョブ読み込みプロセスと類似しています」について、

"ワークオーダーリストには、Neximから転送されたばかりのジョブのみを表示させることを要望。

さらに、ジョブが読み込まれた後、そのジョブは機械の画面上の作業指示リストから削除されるようになってほしい。"

こちらの文面を読みますと、NXTⅢでのバックグラウンド伝送(次生産ジョブ切り替え)をNXTRでも対応してほしい要望にも聞こえました。

NXTRもV2.40にて次生産ジョブ切り替え機能​に対応しました。

Neximからバックグラウンドに予め次生産ジョブを伝送すると、装置画面上では次生産ジョブのみが表示されます。また、次生産ジョブのダウンロードを開始すると、次生産ジョブが現生産ジョブに切り替わり、装置画面上では次生産ジョブが空となります。(次生産ジョブ切り替え.pngを参照)

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_can't clear the 8F15 error._8F15エラーが解除出来ない。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
This is a ticket related to CC-0074735.

We tested and reproduced the issue where the 8F15 error cannot be cleared, so we have captured the trace again. Please investigate.

・9:56: With the backup pin held by the head, enable the feeder lift detection to trigger an 8F15 error.

・9:56–9:59 The 8F15 error prompts the following sequence: unclamp module → remove backup pin → clamp module. However, even after performing these steps, clamping the module causes the system to display the unclamp module, remove backup pin, and clamp module prompts again, creating a loop that prevents the 8F15 error from being cleared.

At 9:56:08, I confirmed that the backup pin was definitely removed and that the Z-axis was raised due to RH28.

10:00: Since the error could not be cleared, I acquired a custom trace at this point.

10:03: Restarted the machine, turned the backup pin function OFF and then ON to restore normal operation.

Since this procedure must always be followed to resolve an 8F15 error, I believe you can reproduce the issue by following the steps above.

Since the 8F15 error message instructs you to unclamp the module, remove the backup pin, and unclamp the module again—without mentioning pressing the reset button—I believe the system remembers that the error hasn’t been cleared, which is why it only appears once in the event log.

Since a reboot and toggling the function ON/OFF are absolutely necessary, and the recovery process takes time, please verify this on the actual machine. We have encountered this issue about twice so far and have not been able to identify the cause.

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_If change the backup pin for the temporary operation function on the single-side robot, the machine will detect the presence of PCB._片側ロボットの故障時運用のバックアップピンをOFF、ONすると基板ないのに基板検知する。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Call Center Team

An issue has arisen where the machine reports a PCB is present even though none is installed, depending on whether the backup pin for failure mode Temporary operation is set to OFF or ON.

Since this occurs consistently, I think you will be able to reproduce it by testing on the actual machine.

Test on 2R M1

・17:40: Changed the backup pin Temporary mode operation on the L side from "Use" to "Do not Use."

The R side remains set to "Use" (= backup pin enabled)

・17:42: On the L side, changed the backup pin failure mode from "Do not use" to "Use".

The R side remained set to "Use" (= backup pin enabled)

・17:43: Setting the L side to "Use" triggered the action to pull the conveyor rail toward the operator.

*An 8AC1 error occurred at this time, but please ignore this error as it was caused by forgetting to return one backup pin.

・17:44 : When the machine starts, the reference points for L-side Lanes 1 and 2 are positioned closer to the operator, causing the lanes to narrow. At this time, the R-side performs a PCB check. Although there is no PCB present, it incorrectly detects the L-side conveyor as a PCB, triggering a 927C error.

・To resolve this issue, the left-side Lane 1 reference and Lane 2 reference must be adjusted so they do not fall between the right-side Lane 1 reference and the dependent lane. This requires pulling out the module and widening the space.

・The left-side lanes were widened, and the conveyor sensor sensitivity was adjusted to restore operation.

The "Use" and "Do Not Use" settings for the backup pins during fault operation were communicated in CC-0074735. Since the system cannot be restored unless these settings are switched every time an 8F15 error occurs, we switch the settings; however, due to the issue described above, restoration takes time.

The problem is believed to be caused by the left-side conveyor lane causing the right-side conveyor sensor to make a false detection.

TOPIC: Urgent[MITAC TECHNOLOGY (VIETNAM) COMPANY LIMITED]_There is no MaterialsLoaded message received._「MaterialsLoaded」メッセージは受信されていません。[Nexim]
Communication Content:
FMV-DO-san

We have identified that this issue is caused by a defect in the CFX Interface.

When the Material Database and Traceability Database are installed on separate PCs, the service name of the Material Database becomes empty. As a result, the system cannot connect to the Material Database, and the MaterialsLoaded notification is not issued.

The root cause is an issue in the data retrieval process, and we are implementing a fix.

Temporary Workaround

As a temporary workaround, please install both the Material Database and the Traceability Database on the same PC and ensure they can be properly referenced in the system layout.

Future Action

A patch addressing this issue will be released at the end of June.

Call center Amano

TOPIC: Urgent[Hana Micron Vina Co., Ltd. (Bac Giang)]_Pickup Rate Issue on NXTR-S at Hana Micron_NXTR-SのPickup Rateの問題[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
森谷さん

顧客訪問して状況確認致しました。

結論、サクセスレートが悪い状況はセンターピン付きが原因ではないと思われる。

手感でセンターピン付きと通常の通りセットにセットしたリールの回転を確認しましたが、

手感で分かるレベルで、センターピン付きはスムーズでした。

なので以前のリールが回転する際に引っかかって、吸着不良に繋がっているわけではなさそう。

又サクセスレートがいい時、悪い時ありますが、前回はリールが新しい時に吸着不良が多く発生していたが、

現在はランダム。

その為ヘッドメンテ状況を確認した所、エアー清掃、グリスアップはしているが、

周期も長く、FUJI推奨の周期でなかった。またメカバルブもかなり汚れており、メンテ状態が悪い為、サクセスレートが低下していると思われる。

ASMと比べられて、ASMはFUJIの様な頻繁なメンテしなくても問題ないという苦言を言われましたが、

まずは切り分けの為に、FMVのスペアヘッドと交換してメンテ状況が悪いからサクセスレートが低下しているという流れに持って行こうと思います。

今後の対応

・ヘッド入れ替えデータ取得、メンテの必要性を理解してもらうように持って行く。

・吸着圧を測定して、ヘッドコンディションを確認。

上記の為、プレートは問題ないと思われる。

このままオープンもでいいですし、一度Closeして貰い、切り分けが出来た際にまだプレート改善が必要となれば新しいチケット作成でもいいです。

FMV 高津

TOPIC: Urgent[MERRY & LUXSHARE (VIET NAM) CO.,LTD]_Nexim application hang out_[Nexim]
Communication Content:
Dear Tan-san

The event log shows frequent records of heap exhaustion errors.

Since the issue appears to be resolved temporarily after restarting the PC, it is highly likely that the heap is the cause.

Please try expanding the heap memory using the following method.

※ Since this involves modifying the registry, proceed with caution.

Please carry out this task under the supervision of the customer’s IT department.

Also, be sure to save the contents before making any changes.

-----------------------------

1. Click [Start], type “regedit” in the [Search] box, then click [regedit.exe] in the [Programs] list.

2. Locate and click the following registry subkey:

HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\SubSystems

3. Right-click the [Windows] entry and click [Modify].

4. In the [Edit String] dialog box, under the [Value data] section, locate the SharedSection entry. Then change the second and third values to 1.5 times their original values.

For example, if the original values are:

SharedSection=1024,20480,768

Set the values to 1.5 times 20480 and 768.

The modified values will be:

SharedSection=1024,30720,1152

--------------- --------------

Note:

The expansion values are not guaranteed.

It may be necessary to increase them each time.

Thank you

BR

Hamamoto

Dear Long-san

I have reviewed the air piping diagram.

Based on the trace results, it appears that the nozzle cleaning valve is indeed the cause.

＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊

Looking at the trace for error code 8CC4198D, the operation of the nozzle cleaning valve seems suspicious.

In the piping integrity check conducted prior to the occurrence of error 198D,

Vacuum breakdown pressure check: XN 0002352641.215 TID:0264 Actual, Threshold 9.80392 5

Nozzle cleaning pressure check: XN 0002353398.219 TID:0264 Actual, Threshold 44.1176 70

An error is occurring here because the pressure has not exceeded 70 kPa.

The system has been restarted several times since then, and

Vacuum breakdown pressure check: XN 0002448964.311 TID:0264 Actual, Threshold 117.647 5

The vacuum breakdown pressure is abnormally high.

I believe the reason such a high pressure is being recorded is that the nozzle cleaning valve is not closing completely.

＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊

TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE-ICT(VAN TRUNG) COMPANY LIMITED]_High ground resistance value_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear FMV  Konda San,

We followed your suggestion to divide the measured path into three parts for verification:

① From the ground point of the power connection on the NXTR to each screw on the cover

② From the ground point of the power connection on the conveyor to each screw

③ From the ground points of the power connections on both the NXTR and the conveyor

1. We found that the grounding resistance of the base is normal, but the grounding resistance of the module is abnormally high.

2. We also measured the grounding resistance of the NXTIII using the same grounding source as the NXTR. The results showed that the grounding resistance of both the base and the module of the NXTIII was normal (the measured resistance values were less than 1 Ω).

For details, please see the attached PowerPoint file "Method and Measurement Results" to confirm.

Currently, we have not identified the root cause and have not yet established a solution to this issue.

We report this anomaly to Fuji, Japan, to request support in identifying the root cause, as well as proposing both temporary and long-term corrective actions.

We hope to receive support from you all.

FMV: Thuong

TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE-ICT(VAN TRUNG) COMPANY LIMITED]_High ground resistance value_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear FMV Thuong san,

The customer measured the resistance between the adjacent conveyor and the cover fixing screws of the NXTR. This measurement includes the factory equipment and conveyor's ground lines.

We recommend breaking down the measured path into three sections for verification:

① From the ground point of the power connection on the NXTR to each screw on the cover

② From the ground point of the power connection on the conveyor to each screw

③ From the ground points of the power connections on both the NXTR and the conveyor

Regarding section ①, the measurement was taken using the cover fixing screws as the frame. However, the tightness of the screws and any paint seeping into the screw holes could have an effect.

We recommend measuring in an unpainted area.

Furthermore, for measuring the ground resistance of the equipment, we maintain a minimum resistance of 0.1Ω between the grounding point of the power connection (from the factory side) and each piece of equipment and each ground terminal. The fixing screws of each cover are not included in the measurement.

Call center / Konda,

Dear Call Center

A nozzle picker failure occurred today.

Sequence of Events

・10:00  Setup changeover for the next production run.

・10:02  An 8F15 error occurred during the changeover. At this time, an FMV engineer inspected the interior, removed the backup pin from the head, and returned all backup pins on the backup plate to the stoker.

・10:20  Since the 8F15 error could not be reset even after returning the Z-axis to its normal position, the machine was restarted.

・10:21  The machine started, triggering an 8F5B error (this was caused by manually removing the backup pin).

・Restarted the machine.

・10:25  Turned Auto Back Pin back ON.

・Restarted the machine.

・10:27  8F15 and 8B75 errors occurred. Confirmed that the head was still holding the backup pin.

While the FMV engineer was checking the internal situation through the side cover, the Liteon engineer started the machine.

The head moved to the reject box and the picker broke.

Please confirm and answer the following four points:

・Why can’t 8F15 be reset even after returning the Z-axis to its normal position?

・When clearing the backup pin error, we have been instructed to move the Y-position toward the operator.

I would expect an error to occur again after 8F15 when the Y-axis reaches its position, but why did that not happen?

Was it because the unit had already dropped due to the 8B75 error?

・The backup pin was still held during the 8B75 error. Please analyze the cause of this false detection.

・This is not urgent at all, but an 8F5B error triggers an instruction to unclamp the module.

However, when I try to follow the instruction, an 8EBF0907 error occurs. The remaining tape box is fine.

The emergency stop was simply pressed, but please add that releasing the emergency stop is part of the procedure for addressing this error.

Communication Content:
Dear Tung-san

CC Takatsu-san, Akira-san

1. Regarding the photo taken at 22:48:

  We have checked, and the system does not stop at this position after autonomous operation.

  When removing or returning pins from the stacker, the conveyor width is typically at its minimum. In the photo, the width is at its maximum.

2. Regarding the axis positions of each trace:

① Acquired on 3/24 at 22:43: Archive_03_20260324154331

② Acquired on 3/24 at 22:48: Archive_04_20260324154835

③ Acquired on 3/24 at 23:00: Archive_00_20260324160034

There were no signs of automatic operation between the end of ① and ②.

However, it was found that the Y-axis positions differed in each trace.

This indicates that there were signs of manual movement during this period.

The following is a chronological list.

Y-axis position [pulse] at the time of the error: 5343154

Y-axis position [pulse] at the end of ①: 7833159

Y-axis position [pulse] at the end of ②: 6794019

Based on the above, it appears that during the response to the error, the operator moved the axis without realizing the pin was in place, causing interference with the lane.

We discussed the warranty coverage for this incident with the relevant parties.

We will grant warranty coverage for this specific incident only.

However, we cannot accept warranty claims for similar operational errors in the future.

If error codes 8B75 or 8F15 appear, be sure to pull out the module and check for any pins before moving the axis.

BR.

Moriya

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Request for investigation and support in resolving the issue :The mounter NXTR-S requires tape reel verification after parameter edited ( or component recognition) on the machine ._NXTR‑S において...
Communication Content:
Dear Sir Marie Terazawa

Sorry for the delayed response, as additional time was required to review the system history and related records.

Based on our verification results on NKS, we would like to confirm the following:

.During the job retransmission process (including cases where the job was edited via the On-Machine Editor or JobEditor and resent to LinConsole), the DID itself remained in the system.

.We did not observe any deletion of DID master data in NKS when the issue occurred.

.Therefore, the possibility that DIDs themselves were deleted can be excluded.

  From the data perspective, the observed behavior is more consistent with ID information or DID–job/slot mapping being cleared or reset, rather than actual DID deletion.

Regarding Operator Trace, we understand and agree with your statement that:

.No delete-related records were found for DID or ID.

.If deletion had occurred through standard operations, it should have been recorded in Operator Trace.

     .At this stage, we cannot exclude the possibility that external tools accessing the DB (such as the First Tech integration tool) may have an impact on ID or mapping behavior, although no direct evidence has been found so far.

We will continue to monitor the system behavior after the recent minor setting adjustments.

To support further investigation, please let us know if there is any additional data, logs, or specific information you would like us to collect from our side.

Thank you for your continued support and cooperation.

Best Regards

Nguyen Anh

Results of the Failure Investigation

We have determined that pulling the tape to remove it can also cause failures on this particular circuit board.

Compared to previously identified incidents, pulling the tape even harder caused damage to a different component.

The change in the type of fuse that blows is due to the change in the component that was damaged.

We are currently exploring countermeasures, but in the meantime, please remind users once again to refrain from pulling the tape to remove it.

BR.

Moriya

TOPIC: Normal[LUXSHARE-ICT(VAN TRUNG) COMPANY LIMITED]_Question related to the AVL data on Fujitrax_Fujitrax における AVL データに関する質問[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Cao Tuan-san,

Thank you for the update.

In Fujitrax, the AVLLIST table is not deleted and there are also no plans to support.

Please note that in Nexim, starting from Version 3.2.0, the behavior was changed so that the data is deleted during transmission.

If the transmission is executed only for Module 12, part A2 will be updated.

However, AVL1 is also used by Module 11.

When transmitting only to Module 12, Module 11 will remain unchanged.

Therefore, we recommend transmitting the data to all modules.

Thank you and Best Regards,

Marie Terazawa

Customer Service Dept.

Dear Fuji Call center support,

I am Mr. Tai from Fuji machine Vietnam and I have a request about MPI function from Hosiden customer need you to support.

On their customer models, they have an IC component measuring 13x11.5 with identification markings on the top surface.

After placement, there will be no AOI check for this IC component; they will place the shield immediately and it's impossible to see underneath the shield., making it impossible to check if the IC is properly placed and if it is missing, misaligned, or has reverse polarity.

However, under the conditions of the MPI function, it is only possible to check components with dimensions smaller than 9.4x9.4.

I explained to the customer about Fuji's algorithm, the camera's capture area, how to compare the actual image to the sample, etc., but Japan manager - they still wanted a way to capture a small area containing letters on the component's surface.

And if possible, they would like FUJI to develop a feature to capture letters on the component body in a small area in the future, as they will be mass-producing this product extensively later on.

Attached is the "MPI over part size.rar" file, which includes :

- ComponentImage.png : Actual component image.

- Nexim_PCB.png : overview full PCB

- Nexim_PartShape_Body.png : part size

- Nexim_NozzleSize.png : nozzle use

- Nexim_Package.png : package type

- LineBalance.png : Line balance error

- LineBalance_Log.png : Line balance error log

- Datacheck.png : Data check error

Question :

- Is it possible to develop a future feature that captures a small area to identify letters on component bodies and compares it to a template to better assist Hosiden customers?

- If possible, how long is it expected to take?

The above are customer questions regarding the MPI function, and we would appreciate your support.

Look forward to your response.

Thanks and best regard,

Fmv Le Thanhh Tai (Mr.)

TOPIC: Urgent[GOERTEK TECHNOLOGY VINA CO.,LTD]_Binding method when PCBRECNO of placement table ≥ 1_[Nexim]
Communication Content:
Dear Call center,

we support customer goertek nam son and hit to this case:

Phenomenon:

Line 4 production then have a PCB was stuck between Module 9 and Module 10.

At that time, Module 9 still retained the PCB information.

The operator manually pushed the PCB into Module 10 and pressed the “Start” button all module 9 and module 10.

As a result, the PCB was recognized with different PCBRECNO values at placement table:

• PCBRECNO = “0” for Modules 1–9

• PCBRECNO = “1” for Module 10 and downstream modules

Reference Image name: (placement)

At the BLOCKLINK table:

• only have PCBRECNO = 0

• don't have PCBRECNO = 1

Reference Image name: (Blocklink)

=> Impact:

the PLACEMENT table and BLOCKLINK table maintained is PCBRECNO = 0,  so factory MES system can automatically upload the board information.

However, when PCBRECNO = 1 at the PLACEMENT table and at the BLOCKLINK table PCBRECNO = 1 not existing( image name: blocklink)

=> As a result, the factory MES system need manually upload the board information, which affects production efficiency and also easy to make a mistake

such as Last time, the operator uploaded the binding information incorrectly: BLOCKNO 401 and 402 were mixed up, which resulted in the board being scrapped.

FMV Proposed Solution: We recommend pushing the PCB back into Module 9 and resuming production.

In this way, PCBRECNO will be reset to “0” across all modules, and normal MES interaction can be restored.

Customer Request:

The customer has requested that Fuji modify the system logic so that the binding between BLOCNO and BLOCKID of BLOCKLINK table is maintained even when PCBRECNO ≥ 1.

for example: at the PLACEMENT table have PCBRECNO ≥ 1, required that at the BLOCKLINK table also have record PCBRECNO ≥ 1

pls support us to have an advise for this case

thank you !

FMV-Long

TOPIC: Urgent[GOERTEK MICROELECTRONICS VINA CO., LTD.]_M2M cannot transmit board skip information to the LCU._[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Viet-san

The following are possible causes for RBS files not being created

1. The remote command “BOARD_SKIP” was not sent from the user host.

2. FEIBIF (SECS/GEM interface) failed to receive the sent “BOARD_SKIP” command.

3. FEIBIF received “BOARD_SKIP” but failed to create the RBS file.

To isolate the cause of the failure, please retrieve the following LCU folders when creation fails:

D:\Ftproot\Trace\LCU\CentralServer

D:\Ftproot\Trace\LCU\SecsGem

Note：Please connect to the LCU via Remote Desktop to retrieve these files.

Please carefully note the file paths.

If cause 1 is responsible, no log entry will exist. Please also provide the time the creation failed.

Thank you

BR

Hamamoto

Although, the FaultOccurred should be reported as information related to an error and does not mean it is reporting the device’s status.

From the attached excel, I see that the customer is asking the report of which could be set in the Accessory.

In many cases, this status occurs in situations where the machine is still capable of operating but due to certain conditions

(for example, the existence of a slot in a “production not allowed” status), the status is transitioned.

This does not mean that the machine has stopped due to an error.

This is the Accessory setting for the announce of status and not for Warning.

So there is no plan to support the machine status.

If the customer strongly requests to support, it will be special request.

If so, please kindly discuss with the salesperson in charge and raise the request.

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Machine is too hot inside affect to the solder quickly dry._装置内温度が高くはんだがすぐに乾いてしまう。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
コールセンター御中　加藤さん

2/24-3/2にかけてメカ設計（川合氏、岡本氏）に現地訪問いただき調査及び顧客への説明を行いました。

調査結果と今後のアクションについて更新します。

まず、はんだ乾きの原因は大きく分けてA:温度、B:風であることが本社設計の調査で判明しています。

風についてはフィルターから吸気した際にコンベア上の基板に直接風が当たっていたことが確認されているのでカバーを追加して対応。こちらは1ラインのみを対象にテスト的に追加済み。

温度については現地調査の結果を以下に記載します。

【機内温度上昇の原因】

①　吸気フィルターのメンテナンスがされておらず目詰まりを起こしており充分な吸気ができていない

②　背面合わせのラインからの排熱が温度上昇に影響している

③　吸気に対して排気が弱い設計となっているので熱がこもりやすい

【上記に対するアクションと結果】

①　フィルターメンテナンスをすることで吸気時の流量が1m/sec以下⇒3～5m/sec、コンベア表面温度約40℃⇒35℃

②　背面にあるNXT3からの排気熱は最高値で40℃程であるため、まずはNXT3フィルターのメンテナンスを依頼。リフローやAOIなどの排熱の影響も少なからず受けているのでライン後方の温度管理を依頼済み。まずは大型扇風機を設置してもらい熱気の吸気を避ける。2℃前後の温度低下が見込まれる。

③　上記2点を対策しても30℃を少し超える温度になることが本社テストでも判明している。顧客が求める30℃以下を達成するためには追加のファンを設置しなければならない。改造内容は添付資料をご査収ください。

2026/03/03時点のステータスは「現地調査完了し、部集中」。

3月中に部集完了し、社内で最終確認を行ってから現地へ発送、4月中の改造工事を計画中。

まずは対象を1ライン21台に絞り、その後は全ラインへの展開予定。

FMV AKIRA

Regarding units with blown F1 fuses on the feeder control board, warranty service will be provided by returning the board to FUJI for investigation.

Incidentally, as a countermeasure against T24014 damage, a revision incorporating a protection circuit into the control board has been implemented.

Reason:

The cause of the blown F2 fuse is due to pulling out the tape while power is applied, which is already documented in SMTR T24014. Conversely, the cause of the blown F1 fuse is currently unknown.

Actions Required:

1. Sort the faulty boards.

2. Re-circulate SMTR T24014.

3. Observe actual operations to check for any hidden failure factors.

フィーダ制御基板のF1ヒューズが切れている物に関してはワランティ対応してFUJIに基板返却して調査することになりました。

理由：

F2ヒューズが切れている原因に関しては通電したままテープを引き抜いたからであり、これはSMTR T24014で周知済み。対してF1ヒューズが切れる要因は現時点で不明。

やってほしいこと

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_All services are stopped after the LCU computer restart._LCUコンピューターの再起動後、すべてのサービスが停止します。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Sir,

We re-investigated the issue and would like to report our findings.

When checking the Windows System Event Log, we found that the network interface was reset on 2026/2/1 at 09:49:31.

Since the FUJI protocol’s cipher.cpt depends on the network adapter, the reset appears to have caused a mismatch between the encrypted file and the actual network adapter at the next startup, resulting in the error.

Error in the event log:

“The network interface Intel(R) Ethernet Connection (17) I219-LM has begun resetting. The network connection will be temporarily interrupted during the hardware reset. Reason: The network driver requested that it be reset. This network interface has been reset once since it was last initialized.”

The first PC reboot after this occurred at 2026/2/2 12:11:04.

Since then, a mismatch between the encrypted file (cipher.cpt) and the actual network adapter seems to have been occurring, which we believe is the cause of the error.

Kernel Power Manager log:

“The kernel power manager has initiated a shutdown transition.

Action: Power Action Reboot

Event Code: 0x0

Reason: Kernel API”

BR

Chi/Fuji

TOPIC: Urgent[JABIL VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Vacuum monitoring function  based stop setting_[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Phuong san,

Please update this ticket.

A negative pressure NG in AHC is caused by an air leak, so filter contamination is not related.

In NXTIII and AHC, negative pressure is generated by a vacuum pump and an ejector, respectively.

Since AHC performs the inspection at a lower supply pressure, it effectively checks more strictly than NXTIII.

Due to mechanical differences, it is not possible to make NXTIII and AHC completely identical.

When using H24S on NXTIII, the higher supply pressure likely means that there is either no leak,

or the leak is not large enough to cause an error in negative pressure monitoring.

Based on the measurement results from AHC, deterioration or wear of the center shaft collar bearing is suspected.

Since this may eventually affect operation even when used on NXTIII, repair of the H24S is recommended.

BR

Chi/Fuji

Dear Sir,

We have reviewed two trace logs.

V10.10 does not address either of the errors.

8CDE Error

In this case, the error is caused by a pickup failure when the Q-axis speed is not set to Hi.

In V10.10, countermeasures are implemented only for the Hi Q-axis speed.

At present, we are proceeding with an investigation into countermeasures for the 8CDE error when the Q-axis speed is other than Hi.

1912 Error

In this case, during mounting with the B holder, the axis moves approximately 3 degrees, and the pickup does not complete in time, resulting in the error.

This issue is different from the 8CDE countermeasure in V10.10, and therefore separate countermeasures need to be considered.

If available, please provide information on the occurrence frequency, such as the ratio between 8CDE and 1912 errors.

TOPIC: Urgent[JABIL VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Vacuum monitoring function  based stop setting_[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Phuong san,

If the vacuum pressure drops due to leakage at a nozzle that has failed to pick up a component, the pickup operation is skipped.

← This is an internal specification and does not require any setting.

If the skip occurs consecutively for the configured number of times, an error is generated.

← [Vacuum Monitoring Function Based Stop Setting] This is the item that can be configured this time.

As shown in the attached photos, a clogged filter also causes a drop in vacuum pressure, so we believe this function will be effective. For example, if you set it to 3, it will stop if 3 consecutive errors occur in folder A.

The same applies to folder B.

BR

Chi/Fuji

Communication Content:
Dear Moriya-san,

I would like to confirm my understanding of the report as follows:

- There is a significant difference in feeder temperature between NXTR (Feeder 08F) and NXT3 (Feeder 08F). The reasons are:

- The NXTR feeder operates at a much higher speed compared to the NXT feeder, even though both are Feeder F.

- The NXTR feeder is more affected by cabin temperature and cabin air flow.

- Fuji is working to reduce feeder temperature by lowering the Module CPU box temperature. Could you please advise on possible methods to reduce CPU box temperature?

- In any case, feeder temperatures below 60°C remain within the acceptable design range.

Thank you very much for your guidance.

Displaying it during the selection of the mounting sequence or feeder does not have much significance, so there are no plans to implement it.

2025/12/10 17:18:35.193: 171835 ModuleSeq:15056:18(NXTR3)::SQL Info:  10810:2025/12/10 17:18:35.186:O 0:SELECT ProgID1,ProgID2,ProgID3,ActCycleTime1,ActCycleTime2,ActCycleTime3,PALETTETYPE FROM MachineStatus2 WHERE McID=18 and ModuleNo=1

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_LCU services did not start automatically_LCUサービスは自動的に開始されませんでした[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Binh-san

Additional information from the design department.

When the LCU DataAccessService starts, the OS may not have completed initializing the network drivers or adapters.

This issue may occur because the key initialization process attempts to use network information but cannot retrieve it.

→Regarding this issue, please confirm whether reinstalling Windows resolves it.

If the issue persists, please apply the latest Intel NIC driver.

Please download and apply the latest Intel NIC driver from the Internet (Intel official website recommended).

Possible Causes:

・NIC driver issues (particularly I219-LM, with numerous reports on Windows 10/11)

・Power-saving settings (Energy Efficient Ethernet, Wake on LAN)

・BIOS or chipset compatibility issues

・Driver incompatibility after OS updates

Solutions:

・Apply the latest Intel NIC driver (recommended from Intel's official website)

・Update BIOS

・Disable NIC power-saving features in Device Manager

・Uncheck “Turn off to save power” under “Power Management”

・Disable “Energy Efficient Ethernet” in Advanced Settings

・Reset network settings (e.g., `netsh winsock reset`)

Please continue to take security-related countermeasures.

Please let me know if there is any progress.

Thank you

BR

Hamamoto

After changing the ini file, it is necessary to run \Nexim\Server\Bin\ProNaviDBCatalogSpecUpdater.exe.

This will only update the ProNaviDB on the PC where ProNaviDBCatalogSpecUpdater.exe is executed.

Communication Content:
Dear Tung-FMV-san,

Resend due to wrong attention.

Sorry for the delay of reply.

This error occurs because there is a problem with the Feeder location and the proper Panel stop position cannot be found.

Currently, error factors such as feeders or nozzles during Panel stop position optimization are not displayed as error messages.

We have confirmed two causes of the error:

- A part requiring height check is placed on a module without IPS

 Workaround: Please delete the feeder for part number "20106-035280A000" located in slots [6 - 46].

- The mounting sequence causes interference between the nozzle flange and the component

   Workaround: Please place the feeder for part number "20106-005770A000" (which is mounted later) on module 3 or 4.

Reference: Component height, part number, module-slot

C464  0.300  20106-005770A000  2-44

C474  1.400  20106-035510A000  2-43

- Please perform optimization with feeders fixed.

If you want to check errors caused by feeders, you can confirm by fixing the PCB stop position.

However, currently, decimal point error may occur, so please adjust the offset value so that the interval becomes 115 mm.

Thank you and Best Regards,

Marie Terazawa

Quality Assurance Dept.

Callcenter FUJI CORPORATION

Thank you for the inquiry.

From the log, it seems that the settings required to connect to MobileConductor via rabbitmq-fuji have not been configured correctly, and the service cannot start.

Please follow the steps below:

① Open the following URL on the PC where rabbitmq-fuji is installed using Google Chrome or Edge:

http://192.168.39.198:54801

※ We assumed that 192.168.39.198 is the IP address of the PC where rabbitmq-fuji is installed. If this is incorrect, please use the correct IP address of that PC.

If you cannot open the URL, proceed to step ②.

If you can open the URL, try logging in with the following account:

Username: FujiSuperUser

Password: FujiSuperUser

If login fails, try the following account:

Username: guest

Password: guest

If both fail, proceed to step ②.

If you successfully log in, please open the “Queues and Streams” tab and the “Admin” tab and take screenshots.

After completing this, proceed to step ②.

② Check the following two files. Please retrieve and send these files.

They are located on the PC where rabbitmq-fuji is installed:

C:\Users\<username>\.erlang.cookie   ※ <username> is the currently logged-in user.

C:\Windows\System32\config\systemprofile\.erlang.cookie

These two files must be identical.

If they differ, please try the following steps:

Copy C:\Windows\System32\config\systemprofile\.erlang.cookie

Replace C:\Users\<username>\.erlang.cookie with the copied file

From FSF Installer’s FMenu, execute “Setting FSF Conductor”

After step 3, confirm that the services rabbitmq-fuji and FSF Conductor Interface are running, then start FSF LineNavi Machine IF Service

※ rabbitmq-fuji and FSF Conductor Interface should start automatically after step 3.

Try logging in on TC52x. PC restart is not required.

③ For confirmation:

Check if the following folder exists and take a screenshot (it will be in one of these locations):

C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Roaming\RabbitMQ\

C:\ProgramData\RabbitMQ\

Take a screenshot of the CentralServer properties for line LINE S01 in the system layout.

TOPIC: Urgent[TAISHODO VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED]_Error 8FC5F024 occurred_8FC5F024エラーが発生[AIMEXR]
Communication Content:
品証課御中

本件、AIMEXRのLTR内のPLC交換して復旧したが返却調査が必要です。

既に設計側でメーカに一報入れたようです。詳細は以下を参照。

設計コメント：

本件におきましては、既に現地サポート用のグループチャットの「第２工場の装置で8FC5F024エラーが発生。」でやり取りを行っております。

結論としては、LTR内のPLCを交換したことで装置は復旧しており、PLCに起因する問題であったと判断しております。

現象発生時（LTRを認識しない際）、PLCを目視にて確認していただいたところ、

PLCの通信IFボードのERRのLEDが点灯し続けていることがわかりました（添付の「PLC問題発生時のインジケータ写真.png」参照）。

これはPLCが通電後に実施する初期化が完了してないことを示しており、本来起きえない事象となります。

本事象より、PLCの異常を疑い、交換してもらった結果、改善されLTRを認識しない問題も発生しなくなったと報告があります。

つきましては、原因調査のため、PLCをメーカー調査に出していただけますでしょうか。

事前にメーカー（商社）の安川メカトレック末松九機には話はしております。情報共有しながら調査したいです。

尚、PLCはベースユニットにCPUモジュール等を組み合わせた構成となっており、

今回はどの部分に原因があるかの特定が困難であったため、I/Oモジュールを除くPLCを構成するユニットを一括で交換しております。

第1CS課池

TOPIC: Urgent[Hana Micron Vina Co., Ltd. (Bac Giang)]_Cycle time actually difference between the OPT results show in the accessory._[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
濱本さん

補足させてください。

現在生産中のジョブは8x20=160個入りのトレイを各パネルに60点ずつ装着するようなジョブです。

なので2，3枚に一度はStacked Tray Feeder（STF）1⇒STF2、もしくはSTF2⇒STF1に移動する瞬間が出てくるような生産です。

大幅にサイクルタイムが伸びているのは移動のタイミングではないかと思っています。

①STF1⇒STF2に移動する時にSTF1のトレイ入替が終わらないとSTF2の吸着を始めない

　⇒この動作により数枚に一度、5秒以上サイクルタイムが伸びる。

②STF2⇒STF1に移動するタイミングではノンストップで吸着を開始する点から上記①の動作にどうしても納得がいかない。

③STF1がオリジナル、STF2が静的ネクスト扱いだったのでジョブ上でフィーダ分割をしたが動作は特に変わらず。

④吸着位置が変わるので多少のバラつきは仕方なしは理解可能。おおよそバラつきは1秒前後に収まっているが①の動作の影響で5秒以上ばらつく。

FMV　AKIRA
