TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_RH08 vacuum break too strong_RH08の真空破壊圧が強すぎる[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Nguyen-san

We confirmed the difference in vacuum breakdown pressure between H08M and RH08.

Regarding the pressure adjustment for RH08 (17–22 kPa), this is a condition determined based on factors like pressure response, so it cannot be lowered without restrictions.

Regarding the 10–11 kPa for H08M, this pressure is measured when the surrounding holders are air-vented.

When only the first holder is vented, the pressure can exceed 20 kPa. (Pressure gradually decreases for holders in the middle to rear sections.)

Therefore, since the situation can sometimes be similar to RH08 where all holders are pneumatically independent, I don't believe blow-off necessarily occurs just because it's RH08.

That said, compared to H08M, RH08 does introduce elements that make blow-off more likely. Considering this, we recommend the countermeasure already implemented: turning OFF the vacuum break pressure.

Regarding the risk of components being carried back when vacuum break pressure is OFF: a timer is included to pause briefly at the end of the descent. While this affects CT, we believe the risk of components being carried back is adequately managed.

In conclusion, it is difficult to pre-select components requiring vacuum break pressure OFF due to varying conditions based on solder state and component shape. Furthermore, the conditions differ fundamentally between NXTⅢ and NXTR, so identical implementation using the same data is impossible. As you know, the camera, head, and device are all different, right?

Typically, NPI is conducted to determine the appropriate approach based on the above factors.

BR.

Moriya

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_RH08 vacuum break too strong_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Call Center,

Recently, our customer - Liteon Vietnam - has encountered issues with components being missing or misaligned from their mounting positions on the newly installed NXTR-S production line. Most of the errors involving missing or misaligned components occur during the first time after job converted from Flexa to Nexim.

On 26/Oct/2025, During the first production of the program PS-2601-3S_TOP_R1_L3S25 T REVA ,Error missing of component D631 (part number 20107-045390A000) occur on module no 2,  it is mounted by the RH20 head.

Line configuration: (2R*3 + 1R*1), Head configuration  (RH28*2 + RH20*1 + RH08*3 +RH02*1), direction flow: Right to left.

- By directly inspecting each module after assembly, we found that D631 on module 2 was still present and placed correctly positioned. The D631 was only missing or misaligned after the components of module 3 had been complete all  placements. Therefore, we believe that the settings in part shape data in Nexim job for D631 are fine.

- During the visual inspection around the D631 area, we confirmed that R652 (part number 20107-014920A000) was placed in module 3 by RH08, this components very near missing part D631.

- We also know that NXTR Advanced Operation Manual - Placement accuracy related functions have mention about Specifying the vacuum break operation during placement, this is can setting vacuum Break Pressure Control. After setting Vacuum Break Pressure Mode "Auto" and "Atmospheric" for part shape data R652 (part number 20107-014920A000), the missing component issue no longer occurred.

- For RH08 head mentioned the vacuum break value  within the range 17 to 22 kPa, this value I think is too high and this is cause blow out small components during RH08 go to place components (For H08M in NXT series is 10 to 11 kPa).

If many of components change vacuum break will take long time for adjustment NEXIM job, and cycle time maybe increase. Also we don’t know which components should be adjust before send job to product. The same issue has occurred on most of the four newly installed NXTR lines (S14, S06, S17, S25) currently in production at Liteon. The customer complained that even though the newly installed NXTR machine and all related equipment are brand new, there are still too many missing and misaligned components.

Question:

Could you please check and provide solutions to prevent RH08 from blowing away components that have already been mounted on the PCB but don't need setting for each part shape data "Vacuum Break Pressure Mode" - "Auto" " Atmospheric"

Best regards,

Nguyen Trong Nham (FMV)

Does Fuji Japan has any

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_NXTR-S module 2RV show 879A2D18 error after boot up._NXTR-Sモジュール2RVは起動後にエラーコード879A2D18を表示する。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Binh-san

An abnormal motor capacity was detected during servo wake-up on the X-axis of the 2RV.

The servo amplifier should have read 400W, but instead showed 0W.

Possible causes include the following:

(1) Potential failure to communicate with the encoder

Check for broken wires, stripped insulation, or poor connections in the encoder cable between the servo amplifier and the encoder.

・Check wiring near the X-axis motor for fraying

・Verify the servo amplifier connector is securely seated

・Y-axis flat cable extension connector

This has resolved the issue in past cases.

Unplug and reseat the connector on the extension cable between the X-axis motor and servo amplifier. (Inside the top cover)

(2) Possibility of servo amplifier failure

Please replace the servo amplifier.

(3) Possibility of encoder (motor) failure

Please replace the servo motor.

BR.

Moriya

・Verify the servo amplifier connector is securely seated

・Y-axis flat cable extension connector

This has resolved the issue in past cases.

Unplug and reseat the connector on the extension cable between the X-axis motor and servo amplifier. (Inside the top cover)

(2) Possibility of servo amplifier failure

Please replace the servo amplifier.

(3) Possibility of encoder (motor) failure

Please replace the servo motor.

BR.

TOPIC: Normal[JABIL VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Jabil Request – Removal of Normal Calibration Function (use HBC Only)_[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Sir,

There are the following differences, so we are unable to meet the customer's request.

[Auto Calibration]

This is an essential correction and measurement operation required for using the head. (e.g., measuring the height of each holder, correcting the center of the rotation axis, etc.)

[Hybrid Calibration]

This is a correction and measurement operation performed as part of Auto Calibration.

By using dedicated jig parts and jig nozzles to simulate mounting inside the machine and measure the mounting position, it adds further correction to the Auto Calibration.

- If mounting accuracy is the priority, we recommend **Auto Calibration + Hybrid Calibration**.

- The highest accuracy is achieved with **PAM measurement**, but it requires special jigs (glass substrate + glass parts).

BR

Chi/Fuji

Dear Moriya San,

Thanks a lot for your support.

Let me explain further. When error D716 occurs due to a SIP 2D code reading failure, the Fuji system should still place the component and report to MES which specific component (panel ID, board ID) requires further action to prevent scrapping. The error component will then be linked to the 2D code at the downstream testing station as a compensation measure. At the testing station, the machine can read the chip inside the SIP component and retrieve the 2D code information. This is the process customer is developing for dealing with the failed components.

Your support is greatly appreciated.

Best regards

Tom Li

0051801033.552 TID:216 [K]Pickup 0 114 0 0 0 0 56 2 J2605 **PickupPos XYZQ -43458.5 -294332 -3916.8 0

TOPIC: Urgent[GOERTEK TECHNOLOGY VINA CO.,LTD]_How to place SIP components even D716 occurs_[Nexim]
Communication Content:
Dear call center:

We are supporting Goertek Nan Son and customer has a new requirement. Since the SIP part attrition caused by bottom 2D code reading cannot be solved in the short term (some issues are non-Fuji related, contaminated 2D code, poor printing quality, etc.) The customer currently requires the following to decrease the attrition rate:

1. No matter whether the code reading process is successful or not, the machine should conduct placement. In this way, it can ensure there is no attrition caused by a 2D code scanning problem (error code D716).

2. Furthermore, the machine log should record the location information of any code reading failure part, such as carrier, panel, and board number.

To specify ‘Shape data - 2D code check - recovery count = 1’ will allow the machine to perform placement even when the 2D code reading error happens. Could you confirm if this is a valid solution to meet customer requirement 1?

For requirement 2, by querying the traceability DB by using PCBID (e.g., ‘select * from fujiuser.placement/blocklink where pcbid=…’), the placement position (panel ID, board number) can be identified. Can this fulfill requirement 2?

I have requested to test this function onsite, but the mass production was ongoing, customer didn’t allow stoppage time.  Could you please review the countermeasure for us? Your confirmation or suggestion will be greatly appreciated.

Best regards

Tom Li

Communication Content:
森谷さん

昨日も引き続きHanaで確認を行っていましたが、以下が悪さしていそうです。

15インチリールを使用しており、リールが重たい為、Feeder送り時に負荷がかかり吸着位置が正しくない場合があり、

それが吸着ミス、立ち、吸着位置ずれに繋がっていると思われる。

昨日はCL0122の部品で急に100~200/1Hの吸着不良が発生し、その際にピックアップオフセットを-0.3~+0.3,

同時吸着OFF、ピックアップスピードを10→9に変更したが変わらず、リールの巻を手で緩めて、緩めたリールを常に手で持っていると改善されました。

約15分だけですが、通常のリールの巻が詰まっている状態で15分で50点以上エラー、リール巻きを緩めて手で持っている時,4~6点のエラー。

吸着出来なくなったら、毎回エラーとなるわけではなく、

例えば1ppで10点打つ内の1点だけ吸着エラーとなるのように、RH28、MFU63、TFeederなので、高速で吸着する際に、

わずかな負荷でFeeder送りが間に合わず、吸着エラーとなる時が発生しているのではと考えてます。

該当部品は1時半前後にスプライシングを行い、新しいリールに変わっています。(満載状態:50000点)

この時間を境にエラーが多発し出しています。

又前回報告したCL1043も1時間単位でアクセサリのデータを見ていくと、いい時間帯、悪い時間帯があります。

ただ1時間に約1000点使用しているので5時間に1回はスプライシングでのリール交換が入ります。

データを見ていくと6時間良くて、その後6時間悪いというようなデータもあった為、CL0143はCL0122と同じ要因ではないかもしれない。引き続き確認要

確認したい事

FフィーダーとTフィーダーでリール送り力、テープ巻き取り力の違いがあるか。

現状リール送り力を強くする方法があるか

Communication Content:
森谷さん

本日Hana訪問し、Excelに纏めましたので確認下さい。

フォーカスして欲しいのはM3-RのSlot54(CL0143部品)です。

シフト(7:00~19:00,19:00~7:00)によって他の部品でも500点ほどのディスロジットもありますが、次のシフトでは問題なかったりするので、

まずはM3-RのSlot54(CL0143)部品にフォーカスします。

前回CL0124で吸着が悪かったのはM3-Lで、今回のCL0143はM3-R。

以前にCL0143がどれぐらい悪かったかはまだ見れていない。

Excelでアクセサリの結果を貼っていますが、11日の夜勤帯から13日の昼勤まで毎シフト1000点以上捨てています。同じ部品のM2-44は問題ない。

13日の夜勤から急に結果が良くなり200点前後になっています。

エンジニアからはpickoffsetZを-0.3入れたら安定したと報告がありましたが、Job履歴を確認すると8/27から-0.3で設定されており、

13日に良くなった理由ではありませんでした。ただ現状-0.3入れていても安定している。

その為、イベントLogで変化点を確認しましたが、ヘッドの入れ替えなし、ホルダスキップ等も見られない為変化点が無いですが、改善しています。

その為、なぜ改善したのか分からない状況です。

本日の結果を見るとM3-54で別の部品をセットしていますが、エラー数多くないです。

その為、何が問題なのか分からない状況です。

部品リールの個体差？ヘッドの問題？ギャングピックで問題がある？

まずはオフセットを0にしてどうなるか、ギャングトレランスの確認、ヘッドの再クランプを試そうと思っています。

その後改善されなければヘッド入れ替え。

メカバルブレバーの調整が良くないヘッドも以前あったと聞いていますのでその辺りも確認していく予定ですが、

その他考えれれる要因等あれば教えて下さい。

FMV高津

TOPIC: Urgent[GOERTEK TECHNOLOGY VINA CO.,LTD]_DID has negative quantity_IDの数量がマイナスになっています[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Victor-san,

Is there any update for this case?

If there is no more questions, we would like to close the case.

The minus quantity record as it is difference at the data qty and actual qty inside the reel.

So the only way is to match the data qty/actual qty when start the production and verify the Reel correctly.

If the Splicing tape is used, the qty is adjust when splicing point is detected so there might be reduce.

Although, as this customer does not use the Splicing function, I believe that is not possible to adjust.

If there is reel is remove in middle of use and the data is minus quantity, it may be corrected manually by counting the remaining actual qty with counter machine for example.

The used part count will be report from Machine to Host if it used and accumulate so if past the Qty:0, it will continue production with minus count.

It is specification of system to continue the production event there is difference at the data qty and actual qty which not always accurate count.

And there is no setting or method to stop the count.

Thank you and Best Regards,

Marie Terazawa

Quality Assurance Dept.

TOPIC: Urgent[TONLY ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY VIETNAM CO.,LTD]_8F58 error occurs during production_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Do san,

Please update this ticket. Can we close this ticket?

**[Trace Analysis Result]**

Phenomenon: The nozzle was returned for calibration.

Since "AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned ON, it was judged that the return was successful.

However, 90 ms later, during the return of Holder B,

"AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned OFF, and calibration proceeded as is.

After calibration, when attempting to mount the nozzle, the system recognized the nozzle as present due to "AIX016" remaining OFF, resulting in an error stop.

**[Design Perspective]**

The judgment changed during operation, suggesting that the valve may not have fully closed.

This appears to be the same phenomenon as the solenoid valve malfunction that has occurred in other areas as well.

Countermeasures are currently being considered by the supplier, and we will share any updates as they become available.

BR

Chi/Fuji

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Nexim cycle time is slower than Flexa_FlexaよりNeximのサイクルタイムの方が遅い[Nexim]
Communication Content:
髙津さん

もらったNeximJobにはNXT7Bってマシンがないです。添付のキャプチャとマシン構成が違います。Jobがあっているか確認してください。

ちなみに今あるジョブだとInsertOrderが違いました。ただ手動で合わせてもオプチ結果は同じにならず。

そもそも計算方法に違いがある可能性があります。

ちなみに、問題としてはNXT7B　M12とNXT-8B　M32は同じ構成、同じ設定、同じ部品をつかってるのにNeximかFlexaかで実サイクルタイムが違うってことだと理解しています。

確かにFlexaはジョブのCT：17.31に対し実CT：18.1となり、仕様の5％以内（17.31 ±0.8655)ですので問題無し。

あとはNeximジョブがどんなサイクルタイムが出ているのか確認が必要です。

対象となるジョブを添付お願いします。

5％越えてるなら装置側で確認、5％以内ならNexim側で確認って感じかなと思います。

TOPIC: Urgent[GOERTEK TECHNOLOGY VINA CO.,LTD]_DID has negative quantity_IDの数量がマイナスになっています[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Victor-san,

The minus quantity record as it is difference at the data qty and actual qty inside the reel.

So the only way is to match the data qty/actual qty when start the production and verify the Reel correctly.

If the Splicing tape is used, the qty is adjust when splicing point is detected so there might be reduce.

Although, as this customer does not use the Splicing function, I believe that is not possible to adjust.

If there is reel is remove in middle of use and the data is minus quantity, it may be corrected manually by counting the remaining actual qty with counter machine for example.

The used part count will be report from Machine to Host if it used and accumulate so if past the Qty:0, it will continue production with minus count.

It is specification of system to continue the production event there is difference at the data qty and actual qty which not always accurate count.

And there is no setting or method to stop the count.

Thank you and Best Regards,

Marie Terazawa

Quality Assurance Dept.

Callcenter FUJI CORPORATION

TOPIC: Urgent[TONLY ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY VIETNAM CO.,LTD]_8F58 error occurs during production_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Do san,

Please update this ticket.

**[Trace Analysis Result]**

Phenomenon: The nozzle was returned for calibration.

Since "AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned ON, it was judged that the return was successful.

However, 90 ms later, during the return of Holder B,

"AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned OFF, and calibration proceeded as is.

After calibration, when attempting to mount the nozzle, the system recognized the nozzle as present due to "AIX016" remaining OFF, resulting in an error stop.

**[Design Perspective]**

The judgment changed during operation, suggesting that the valve may not have fully closed.

This appears to be the same phenomenon as the solenoid valve malfunction that has occurred in other areas as well.

Countermeasures are currently being considered by the supplier, and we will share any updates as they become available.

BR

Chi/Fuji

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Machine unable to download the job_ジョブダウンロードができない[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Vu-san

Under investigation.What we know so far

It takes 35 seconds to open an internal job, causing a timeout on the image processing board side.

Other than this issue, processing is running normally, so it is not a shutdown of the LCUDataAccessService itself.

However, since there are no logs between the start and end of the job opening, it is unclear where the delay is occurring.

Points of concern

Immediately after the job open in question, the same work order job open was performed from “another PC.”

The socket of this “another PC” was disconnected, and 5 seconds later, the above job open was completed normally.

What is known so far

・There was a timeout between the M9-R image board and the LCU (Fuji LCU Data Access Service) communication (FDataJobOpen).

• According to the device event log, this occurred once (D475 applies. 2025/8/18 11:18:05).

• D476 is a secondary error caused by the D475 error. It will no longer occur once the D475 error is resolved.

There is also a possibility that there was a delay in LCU processing for some reason at the time of occurrence.

[Request]

・The LCU appears to be a commercially available PC, but what is the OS version? If it is Windows 11 24H2, it is not supported.

・Please obtain the system information for the LCU. The method for obtaining it is as follows. Open the “System Information” by entering it in the search box, then select ‘Export’ from the “File” menu and export it as a text file.

• How frequently does this occur?

• Please check the attached file to confirm that real-time scanning by Defender is disabled on the LCU.Please check whether Defender's real-time protection is turned on or off.*If it is turned on, communication abnormalities may occur due to communication load, etc. If it is turned on, please enable “Disable real-time protection”.

BR.

FUJI Moriya

TOPIC: Urgent[TONLY ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY VIETNAM CO.,LTD]_8F58 error occurs during production_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Do san,

**[Trace Analysis Result]**

Phenomenon: The nozzle was returned for calibration.

Since "AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned ON, it was judged that the return was successful.

However, 90 ms later, during the return of Holder B,

"AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned OFF, and calibration proceeded as is.

After calibration, when attempting to mount the nozzle, the system recognized the nozzle as present due to "AIX016" remaining OFF, resulting in an error stop.

**[Design Perspective]**

The judgment changed during operation, suggesting that the valve may not have fully closed.

This appears to be the same phenomenon as the solenoid valve malfunction that has occurred in other areas as well.

Countermeasures are currently being considered by the supplier, and we will share any updates as they become available.

BR

Chi/Fuji

CC-0056270の問題はJobデータ自体は問題ありませんが、伝送するためのデータ作成時に問題が発生しました。

その為、JobEditor上で問題はありませんが、伝送時のデータチェックなどで問題が発生しました。

また、JobEditor上でのデータチェックと実際に伝送時のデータでのチェックでは確認可能な範囲が違いますので、

JobEditor上では問題ないが、伝送時データチェックや装置ダウンロード時にエラーする場合があります。

今回、Traceフォルダをまるごと取得せず、Optimizerフォルダのみ送られていますが、

Job伝送時の問題の場合はまず、伝送したPCとLineServerPCのTraceフォルダを取得願います。

また、今回のように装置とJobEditorでDatacheckが違う場合、伝送前Datacheckで確認いただけると問題の特定に助かります。

装置トレースに関しては今回、モジュールNo4のみ取得されているようですが、

調査中に比較したりなどで使用する場合もあるので、ライン全部で取得いただいたほうが良いかと思います。

頂いたTXTファイルによると「NXT7AのM4, M5, M6, M10, M17」で発生とありますが、ほかのモジュールでは発生していないのでしょうか？

CC-0056270の問題は共通セットアップ内にQty:0のフィーダがセットされており、そのデータが伝送時に問題となりました。

その為、Qty:０のフィーダがセットされているモジュールエラーし、そのフィーダをJobから削除すると解消されました。

頂いた問題Jobを確認すると「NXT7AのM4, M5, M6, M10, M17」以外でNXT7BのモジュールNo.11にもQty:0のスロットがありました。

しかし、Job伝送時にNXT7A以外のモジュールで問題はなかったのでしょうか？

その場合、CC-0056270とは違う問題の可能性もありますので、別途入手を依頼した復旧に使用したJobとも比べてみたいと思います。

以上、宜しくお願い致します。

Therefore, there are situations where the height will not be -2.9 mm.

TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE-ICT(VAN TRUNG) COMPANY LIMITED]_The remote skip function wrongly skipped  boards._[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Van-san

Sorry for the delay.

To summarize, control is required on the upper host side.

Even though PCBCHEKCKIN_ACK is NG, REMOTEBOARDSKIP is being sent, resulting in redundant skip information.

In this case,

a 9277 error occurred, the board was removed, and the same board was read again, so the skip information was sent twice, causing a discrepancy.

The log also shows that skip information was received in both of the two readings.

Even though the first read was NG, skip information was sent.

Additionally, the machine cannot detect that the same board has sent skip information twice.

Since there are other operations for remote board skip that do not link with the board ID, the device cannot manage using the board ID.

It is assumed that there is one REMOTEBOATDSKIP per board.

BR.

FUJI Moriya

TOPIC: Urgent[Hana Micron Vina Co., Ltd. (Bac Giang)]_Cannot Quick verify feeder type 8F,12C,24C_フィーダータイプ8F、12C、24Cのクイックベリファイができません。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Moriya san

この問題はV2.2VaからV2.2Vcにバージョンアップ後に発生し、バージョンダウンした所、問題なく復旧しています。

LCUもバージョンアップがあったか確認出来ていませんが、LCU側もバージョンアップが入っていた場合、

Centaralのバージョンアップも入っているかもしれません。その為、このバージョンアップが起因していると考えます。

・Hanaのライン構成はM1からM4までMFU-62,M5～M8までをMFU-53を使用しています。

MFU-53でしか段積みトレイFeederを使用出来ない？

その為、MFU-62ではTFeeder、MFU-53ではFFeederを使用しています。

Tフィーダーは問題なく動作、FFeeder＋その他の8F,12C,24Cで問題が発生。

チップ部品はM4まででほとんど実装しており、M5からはトレイ部品がメインになります。

その為、使用している8F,12C,24Cでしか確認は出来ていないですが、TFeeder以外のすべてのFeederで問題が発生したと理解して貰えばいいかと思います。

・最初のFeeder、リール紐づけのベリファイは可能。

・画像処理エラーや、吸着ミス時にFeederを抜くとベリファイで出来なくなります。

・Miss Prevention timmerを使用しているので、通常は設定時間ベリファイは保持されますが、Feederを抜いた瞬間にベリファイ要求が入る。

・その後ベリファイするとベリファイが出来ない。

・DBのT_LOCから該当のFeederIDを消すとベリファイが出来る。

この作業は生産の影響が多い為、すぐにV2.2Aaに戻しています。その為、トレースの取得は出来ていません。

This problem occurred after upgrading from V2.2Va to V2.2Vc.

I have not been able to confirm if LCU also had a version upgrade, but if LCU also had a version upgrade,

I have not been able to confirm if LCU has also been upgraded, but if LCU has also been upgraded, Central may have been upgraded as well.

We believe that the problem is caused by this version upgrade.

The line configuration of Hana is MFU-62 from M1 to M4 and MFU-53 from M5 to M8.

Is it possible to use the stacked tray feeder only with MFU-53?

So we are using T Feeder with MFU-62 and F Feeder with MFU-53.

T Feeder works fine, F Feeder + other 8F, 12C, 24C have problems.

Most chip components are mounted up to M4, and from M5, tray components are the main components.

Therefore, we have only been able to confirm the problem with the 8F, 12C, and 24C feeders that we are using, but we hope that it is understood that the problem occurred with all feeders except the T Feeder.

The first feeder and reel string verification is possible.

If a feeder is unplugged at the time of an image processing error or a sucking error, it will not be able to verify.

The verification is usually held for a set time because Miss Prevention Timmer is used, but a verification request is received the moment the feeder is pulled out.

However, the moment the feeder is unplugged, a verify request is received.

If the corresponding feeder ID is deleted from T_LOC in the DB, verification can be performed.

Since this operation has a lot of influence on production, we immediately reverted to V2.2Aa.Therefore, we are not able to obtain traces.

BR.

FUJI Moriya

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_The NXTR-S 2RV right robot module reported a communication link error on the X-axis board during production._NXTR-S 2RV右ロボットモジュールは、製造中にX軸基板で通信リンクエラーを報告しました。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Dinh-san

We do not believe this issue is related to the damaged ground wire.

The ground wire itself is not essential for the machine's normal operation.

If there were an issue, it would only be if a broken wire were touching somewhere on the circuit board.

However, there is no X-axis power line relay harness (2EHESA0009xx) near the 2RV X-axis control/expansion board.

Therefore, there is no connection between this issue and the damaged ground wire.

Please confirm the X-axis fan (H78139 Terminal Processing: 2AHESF0024xx) , the X-common board (2AHESF0065xx), the X-axis expansion board (2AHESF0063xx).

BR.

Moriya

TOPIC: Urgent[JABIL VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Vacuum monitoring function  based stop setting_[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Phuong san,

A negative pressure NG in AHC is caused by an air leak, so filter contamination is not related.

In NXTIII and AHC, negative pressure is generated by a vacuum pump and an ejector, respectively.

Since AHC performs the inspection at a lower supply pressure, it effectively checks more strictly than NXTIII.

Due to mechanical differences, it is not possible to make NXTIII and AHC completely identical.

When using H24S on NXTIII, the higher supply pressure likely means that there is either no leak,

or the leak is not large enough to cause an error in negative pressure monitoring.

Based on the measurement results from AHC, deterioration or wear of the center shaft collar bearing is suspected.

Since this may eventually affect operation even when used on NXTIII, repair of the H24S is recommended.

BR

Chi/Fuji

TOPIC: Normal[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Load job on each module_各モジュールにジョブをロードする[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
FMV takatsu-san

At Module 4 on the S17 line, Lane 2 began switching to the next production job, and production stopped at the setup guidance screen.

This behavior is as designed for this situation.

First, regarding Module 4, the setting value for “Timing of setup guidance during job change in production” is not related.

This setting only applies in 2R configurations.

For 1R, since there is only one robot, “per robot” and “per module” refer to the same thing.

The key point in this case was that the component in Slot 46, which was being used for production on Lane 1, was raised to the recovery position due to a pickup error.

It is normal and expected behavior for Lane 2’s job to change while Lane 1 is in production (this is according to specification).

Under normal conditions, even if a job that would cause a consistency-check NG on the opposite lane is loaded, production continues.

However, in this case, the component in Slot 46 had been lifted to the recovery position, meaning production could no longer continue.

Therefore, the system exited the production state and displayed the setup guidance.

設計とやり取りしているかと思いますが回答更新しておきます。

Call center Amano

TOPIC: Urgent[JABIL VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Vacuum monitoring function  based stop setting_[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Phuong san,

Since the regulator installed in the AHC and the vacuum pump installed in the NXTIII are different,

the negative pressure reference levels of the NXTIII differ from those of the AHC.

The NXTIII continues production without generating an error as long as the negative pressure level does not affect placement accuracy.

In contrast, the AHC is designed with a preventive approach and therefore detects deviations much more strictly.

As a result, the reported outcome has occurred.

For the setting “Number of Consecutive Inspection Vacuum Error Results to Stop Operation”,

the associated error code is 1958.

The specific vacuum pressure reference values for the NXTIII are internally defined and cannot be changed; therefore, we refrain from disclosing them.

BR

Chi/Fuji

Communication Content:
Dear Tan-san

Can we collect the faulty boards to investigate whether this phenomenon is related to T24014?

We will respond to your questions.

>1. Under what conditions do the F1 and F2 fuses on the W08t main control board blow?

→ If an overcurrent flows through the fuse, or if a component downstream of the fuse experiences a ground fault, an overcurrent occurs, causing the fuse to blow.

　

> Please provide the W08t electrical schematic showing the F1/F2 circuits and clearly indicate the protection targets for both fuses.

→ Protection targets for the fuses:

　F1: Protection for the entire feeder

　F2: Protection for the feed motor control circuit

>2. Based on T24014, if an operator pulls the tape without using the control panel, the control board will be damaged.

>Will the F1/F2 fuses blow in this case? We understand the control board will be damaged. Additionally, what happens to F1 and F2? Will they burn out?

→In previous cases where pulling occurred, the F2 fuse blew.

>3. If the board is damaged due to tape pulling, can replacing fuses F1 and F2 restore the board?

→In this case, replacing the fuses will not restore it.

The control board itself must be replaced.

Additional confirmation points.

・Were any feeder modifications, manual pulling, or other operations performed around the time the feeder failure occurred?

　If there appears to be a triggering cause, could you please specify it?

・You mentioned multiple failures. Could you provide the failure dates and number of units affected?

・You noted normal operation after replacing the control board. Is it still functioning normally now?

BR.

Moriya
